steps: Peel and dice the Sweet potato into 1 cm cubes; peel and finely dice the Onion; mince Garlic and fresh Ginger.
Cook Brown rice according to package directions in a medium saucepan; set aside and keep warm.
Heat Coconut oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add Onion, Garlic and Ginger; cook for 3 to 4 minutes, until softened.
Stir in Turmeric and Ground cumin; cook for 30 seconds, until fragrant.
Add Sweet potato cubes, Crushed tomatoes and Coconut milk; stir to combine.
Cover and cook over medium-low heat for 12 to 15 minutes, until sweet potato is fork-tender.
Stir in drained Cooked white beans; cook uncovered for 3 minutes, until heated through.
Mash a few beans and sweet potato pieces for a smoother texture suitable for babies.
Spoon curry over Brown rice to serve. Yields 4 family portions. Refrigerate for up to 3 days.
